brief_rationale: The doctor established that the patient is in an emergency observation zone with ongoing nurse monitoring, verified current glucose of ~25-26 mmol/L and absence of hypoglycemia symptoms, screened for multiple red-flag symptoms, instructed not to self-adjust insulin, obtained caregiver teach-back, and closed with a concrete written checklist and follow-up plan. No serious responsibility-chain error occurred, and all RCs were met. Two high-order points (HO1: nuanced glucose-number correction, HO4: practical 24-72 hour execution plan) were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact. No important non-chain defect is present. The trajectory satisfies Strong but not Perfect because only one additional high-order point beyond RC safety was fully completed; HO2 and HO3 were partially or not distinctly beyond minimum requirements.
